ambiguities: Overcommitment is described as a stable coping pattern; declared Static.
Health outcomes are cardiovascular in the cited cohorts; the strain construct bundles negative affect with cardiovascular symptoms, which departs from the library's psychosomatic strain.
Evidence declared Longitudinal for the imbalance proposition on the strength of the prospective cohorts the paper reviews.
